headline: IMF warns an AI stock crash could threaten global financial stability
summary: The IMF warned that a crash in high AI-sector valuations could ripple across global markets and threaten world financial stability, citing mounting debt, government borrowing and cyberattacks as compounding risks.

claims.statement: The IMF warned that a crash in AI stock valuations could threaten world financial stability.

sources.quote: Threat of AI share crash puts world financial stability at risk, says IMF
AI bubble could burst and take global economy with it, IMF warns

claims.statement: The IMF's warning cited high AI-sector valuations and debt, alongside concerns about government borrowing and cyberattacks.

sources.quote: High valuations and debt put sector in danger, while fund also warns on government borrowing and cyber-attacks
